title: STAT3 signaling inhibitors for cancer treatment.
authors: Akinsola, Rasaq; Xian, Jing; Turkson, James
one_liner_zh: 综述STAT3抑制剂在癌症治疗中的临床进展，未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Pharmacological targeting of Signal Transducer and Activator of Transcription 3 (STAT3) in cancer has demonstrable antitumor efficacy. However, suitably potent, efficacious, and safe STAT3 inhibitors are scarce, and only a handful have entered clinical trials, limiting our knowledge of the extent of clinical benefit. Outcomes of recently completed trials in advanced cancers range from improved overall survival and complete responses in a cohort of patients with phosphotyrosine STAT3 positivity to partial responses and progressive disease in unselected patients. Advancements in oligonucleotide technologies and the integration of E3 ligase-specific proteolysis-targeting chimeras and molecular glue protein degrader strategies are accelerating the transition of STAT3 inhibitors into clinical testing. This review examines recent STAT3-targeted modalities and their preclinical and clinical activities. It concludes by underscoring the value of biomarker-informed approaches to optimize patient outcomes, combination therapies to improve clinical benefits, and artificial intelligence/machine learning tools to accelerate development.
abstract_zh: 在癌症中，针对信号转导与转录激活因子3（STAT3）的药理学靶向治疗已显示出明确的抗肿瘤疗效。然而，具有适当效力、有效性和安全性的STAT3抑制剂仍然稀缺，仅有少数进入临床试验，限制了我们对其临床获益程度的了解。最近完成的晚期癌症试验结果不一，从在磷酸化酪氨酸STAT3阳性患者队列中改善总生存期和完全缓解，到在未筛选患者中出现部分缓解和疾病进展。寡核苷酸技术的进步以及E3连接酶特异性蛋白水解靶向嵌合体和分子胶蛋白降解剂策略的整合，正在加速STAT3抑制剂向临床测试的转化。本综述探讨了近期STAT3靶向治疗模式及其临床前和临床活性，最后强调了基于生物标志物的方法在优化患者预后、联合疗法在提升临床获益以及人工智能/机器学习工具在加速开发中的价值。
